name: Alex Jones
role: American political broadcaster, author and founder of Infowars
summary: Jones combines constitutionalist and gun-rights advocacy with conspiratorial opposition to global institutions, corporate power and technological control. His recent broadcasts oppose climate policy and the Iran war, while his rhetoric presents politics as a spiritual conflict.

notes:
No inferred answers. Complete accessible broadcast transcripts were downloaded and searched across themes; the full 23-page Mercola interview was read through the PDF tool. A freely accessible complete copy of his Great Reset book was not located, so summaries were not substituted for its text. Allegations are recorded as his claims, not verified facts. His 2022 demand for executions supersedes his 2013 abolition argument; July 2026 impeachment demands qualify earlier support of Trump. August 11, 2024 was guest-hosted by Chase Geiser; October 1, 2026 was mainly hosted by Rex Jones. Their comments, Crowder’s pre-interview monologue, callers, guests and clips were not treated as Jones’s positions. Moral condemnation of abortion does not alone establish his exact legal policy. Opposition to coercive transhumanism does not establish a ban on voluntary enhancement. All 490 statements, including remaining unknowns, were checked against the evidence; criticism of one war does not establish opposition to every possible intervention.
